newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bank of Bahrain, Kuwait lifts Q3 net - paper. [CORRECTED 21:13 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bank of Bahrain, Kuwait lifts Q3 net - paper. [CORRECTED 21:13 GMT]

text.p: Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait made a net profit of 7.2 million dinars in the first nine months of 1996 compared with 5.86 million in the same period last year, a Bahraini newspaper said on Sunday (corrects from "a Saudi newspaper").

Alayam newspaper quoted the bank's general manager Murad Ali Murad as saying an increase in net interest income, more loans and revenue from commissions and foreign exchange fees helped beef up profits.
The Bahrain-based bank is owned equally by financial institutions and investors in Kuwait and Bahrain.
